question: Who conveyed the teaching concerning the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs.
They are described as good eaters.
inference: The teaching concerning the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs was told by an earth-mover.
uncertainties: The instrumental form bhūcarī is unusual and may reflect textual variation.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs by an earth-mover.
